title: A scheme of finite type over a Noetherian scheme is Noetherian (Stacks 01T6)
statement: Call a scheme Noetherian if it is locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact (Stacks Properties, Definition 01OV). Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] with $S$ Noetherian. Then $X$ is Noetherian. In particular $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ is Noetherian ($\mathbf Z$ being a Noetherian ring), so every scheme of finite type over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ is Noetherian.
